body.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: production pixel-art sprite atlas for UMBRAL, a first-person retro 2.5D shooter. Reference image 1 is the existing enemy identity, image 2 is action-pose reference only. Create NEW authored finisher animation poses of EXACTLY this Titan of Obsidian: huge ivory skull face, black jagged obsidian crown and armor, turquoise inlays, ragged red loincloth, black cannon on its right arm (viewer left), exposed molten orange heart inside rib cage. Keep identity and 1990s Doom hand-painted pixel-art rendering.
Transparent RGBA background. Exactly 4 equal square columns and 2 equal square rows, eight cells, seamless exact grid, no borders/text/labels. Every pose is front-facing, floor at 94% cell height, fixed scale, centered, entire body visible, no overlapping into neighboring cells. The Titan is kneeling in every pose except last two collapsed poses. Max kneeling crown height at 19% from cell top, knees/feet at94%; exposed heart center at54% fromcell top. Important: visible knees on floor, lowered body, head thrown upward roaring and open jaw in the initial poses.
Read cells left-to-right top row then bottom row:
0 Titan lowering into knees, bowed slightly then throat up, molten heart exposed.
1 Titan fully kneeling, both knees grounded, head thrown back screaming, cracked chest opened around a bright clearly visible orange heart.
2 Same kneeling vulnerable stance with subtle breath/chest rise, same upturned head.
3 Knife impact reaction, chest jerks backward, an obsidian blade embedded into the glowing heart with a turquoise pommel protruding directly toward camera, no player hands included.
4 Same embedded obsidian knife in heart, forearms slack, head held up, tense before hammering.
5 Violent single hammer impact reaction: orange core cracks into bright sparks and obsidian shards, bent backward head up, same blade embedded, no player weapon or hands visible.
6 Body collapsing forward down onto knees and cannon, core dimming.
7 Collapsed rubble/body on floor, skull/cannon recognizable, dark dead heart.
These are enemy-only sprites, no scene or weapon overlay. No photorealism, no smooth plastic modern3D, no gradients outside sprite. Preserve genuine transparent background.
